import sqlite3, os

db = './abb-tablegpt-umon_l9_/profile/history.sqlite'
print('exists:', os.path.exists(db), 'size:', os.path.getsize(db) if os.path.exists(db) else None)

con = sqlite3.connect(db)
q = "SELECT name, type FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','view')"
print(con.execute(q).fetchall())
# Peek at a couple of rows of any tables
for (name,) in con.execute(q).fetchall():
    try:
        rows = con.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {name} LIMIT 3").fetchall()
        print(name, '->', rows)
    except Exception as e:
        print(name, 'err', e)
con.close()
